name: pkm
description: Clip AI sessions to an Obsidian vault, resolve vault sync conflicts, and file or classify Karakeep bookmarks.
skillInstructions:
Kimi Code tool mapping for the pkm skills.

The authoritative mapping is not in this repo. It lives in the sibling repo `dEitY719/harness-skills` at `references/kimi-tools.md` (https://github.com/dEitY719/harness-skills/blob/main/references/kimi-tools.md) and is the single source of truth for every repo in the `dEitY719/*-skills` family; do not copy it here. Summary:

- "Ask the user" -> `AskUserQuestion`. `pkm:obsidian-resolve-conflict` runs destructive git operations on a real Obsidian vault: every class B (note body) and class C conflict decision must be confirmed through it before anything is written. Never auto-merge a note body.
- `TodoWrite` -> Kimi Code's `TodoList` tool.
- "Dispatch a subagent" -> `Agent` with `subagent_type: "coder"` (implementation) or `"explore"` (read-only). Never pass `general-purpose`.
- Read / Write / Edit / Bash / Grep / Glob keep their exposed Kimi names. Search contents with `Grep`; match paths with `Glob`. The `lib/*.sh` helpers these skills call are plain bash - run them with `Bash` and pass their output through verbatim; do not reimplement them.
- Kimi Code has no `Skill` tool. Where `pkm:karakeep-classify` says `Skill(pkm:karakeep-add, ...)`, `Read` `skills/karakeep-add/SKILL.md` and follow it inline instead; the same applies in reverse when `pkm:karakeep-add` is called without `--list`.
- `pkm:karakeep-classify` declares `WebFetch` for reading a page title and meta description. Use Kimi's own URL-fetch tool if one is exposed, otherwise `Bash` with `curl -sL`. That fetch is optional - host and path usually decide the List, and a full-body fetch is never wanted.

Safety contracts. These are part of the skills, not advice:

- `pkm:karakeep-classify` is read-only and dry-run by default. It prints a proposal and writes nothing unless `--apply` is given, and even then the write is delegated to `pkm:karakeep-add`.
- `pkm:karakeep-add` performs REST writes against the live Karakeep instance (`NEXTAUTH_URL` + `KARAKEEP_API_KEY`, never a hardcoded localhost). It is idempotent - no duplicate List or bookmark - and refuses a public or personal URL under the `Company` subtree.
- `pkm:obsidian-resolve-conflict` merges only: never rewrite vault history, never force-push, never delete `.git/index.lock`, never create a vault to make a path resolve. Print `BACKUP_SHA` before touching anything.
- `pkm:obsidian-session-clip` must never be auto-triggered. Run it only on an explicit request. It commits the single note it created, by pathspec - never `-a`, `-A`, or `git add .` - and never contacts a remote.

interface.shortDescription: Obsidian vault clips and Karakeep bookmark filing
interface.longDescription: PKM bundles the four personal-knowledge-management skills: obsidian-session-clip, obsidian-resolve-conflict, karakeep-add, and karakeep-classify.
